BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain termes)
(:requirements :strips :typing)
(:types
    position
    numb
)
(:predicates
    (at ?p - position)
    (height ?p - position ?n - numb)
    (has-block)
    (NEIGHBOR ?p1 - position ?p2 - position)
    (SUCC ?n1 - numb ?n2 - numb)
    (IS-DEPOT ?p - position)
)

(:action move
    :parameters (?from - position ?to - position ?h - numb)
    :precondition (and
        (at ?from)
        (NEIGHBOR ?from ?to)
        (height ?from ?h)
        (height ?to ?h)
    )
    :effect (and
        (not (at ?from))
        (at ?to)
    )
)

(:action move-up
    :parameters (?from - position ?to - position ?hfrom - numb ?hto - numb)
    :precondition (and
        (at ?from)
        (NEIGHBOR ?from ?to)
        (height ?from ?hfrom)
        (height ?to ?hto)
        (SUCC ?hto ?hfrom)
    )
    :effect (and
        (not (at ?from))
        (at ?to)
    )
)

(:action move-down
    :parameters (?from - position ?to - position ?hfrom - numb ?hto - numb)
    :precondition (and
        (at ?from)
        (NEIGHBOR ?from ?to)
        (height ?from ?hfrom)
        (height ?to ?hto)
        (SUCC ?hfrom ?hto)
    )
    :effect (and
        (not (at ?from))
        (at ?to)
    )
)

(:action place-block
    :parameters (?rp - position ?bp - position ?hold - numb ?hnew - numb)
    :precondition (and
        (at ?rp)
        (has-block)
        (NEIGHBOR ?rp ?bp)
        (not (IS-DEPOT ?bp))
        (height ?rp ?hold)
        (height ?bp ?hold)
        (SUCC ?hnew ?hold)
    )
    :effect (and
        (not (has-block))
        (not (height ?bp ?hold))
        (height ?bp ?hnew)
    )
)

(:action remove-block
    :parameters (?rp - position ?bp - position ?hold - numb ?hnew - numb)
    :precondition (and
        (at ?rp)
        (not (has-block))
        (NEIGHBOR ?rp ?bp)
        (not (IS-DEPOT ?bp))
        (height ?rp ?hold)
        (height ?bp ?hold)
        (SUCC ?hold ?hnew)
    )
    :effect (and
        (has-block)
        (not (height ?bp ?hold))
        (height ?bp ?hnew)
    )
)

(:action create-block
    :parameters (?p - position)
    :precondition (and
        (at ?p)
        (IS-DEPOT ?p)
        (not (has-block))
    )
    :effect (has-block)
)

(:action destroy-block
    :parameters (?p - position)
    :precondition (and
        (at ?p)
        (IS-DEPOT ?p)
        (has-block)
    )
    :effect (not (has-block))
)

)
END DOMAIN
